name: Public Works Department, Government of Mizoram
summary: The state department that builds and maintains Mizoram's state highways, major district roads and bridges.
about: Mizoram is almost entirely hills, and its Public Works Department maintains roads that run along ridgelines and cling to slopes. Roads are the only practical transport in most of the state, and monsoon landslides are the constant threat to them.
facts: Responsible for Mizoram's state highways and major district roads.
Also looks after most state-owned bridges and government buildings.
National highways in the state are not its responsibility — those belong to NHAI, NHIDCL or the state's national highway wing.
